text:
Maria L.: Quick follow-up from the onboarding RFC — we're seeing bench variance when models run on A100 vs H100. Throughput diffs ~20% and some smokes failing only on H100.
Samir P.: Hmm, is the failure functional or perf-only?
Maria L.: Perf for most, but one env hit a tokenizer mismatch (rare). Looks like quantization path differences too.
Anya (ML): Can you paste the failing log? Also which docker layers differ?
Maria L.: pasted: ```
ERROR: tokenizer mismatch at token 0: expected 42 got 255
perf: throughput A100 420 tok/s, H100 510 tok/s
```
Chris B.: Two quick thoughts: 1) separate the acceptance gates: functional smoke (deterministic) vs perf bench (statistical). 2) record hardware profile with each run (driver/cuda/cudnn versions, SM arch, cuPerf).
Samir P.: Agreed. For perf bench we need calibration runs to normalize clock/power scaling. Propose adding a per-machine calibration factor computed from the standard microbench (matrix multiply) and store it as metadata.
Anya (ML): Calibration factor is fine, but don't bias golden thresholds to it — keep two thresholds: raw and calibrated. Alert on raw regressions too.
Devon R.: Also: quantization implementation diverges across kernels. We should add a deterministic quantized smoke (small input) to the functional suite that runs on CPU fallback and GPU path to catch mismatches early.
Maria L.: Good. Can we avoid blowing up CI time? Maybe run full perf nightly and quick deterministic checks on PRs.
Chris B.: Yep — PRs get deterministic smoke + checksum of embedding outputs. Nightly runs trigger the full bench and post results to the model's intake page.
onboard-bot: label added: needs-calibration, needs-runbook
Samir P.: I'll sketch the change: intake metadata gets new keys: hardware_profile, calibration_factor, driver_hash, nightly_bench_id.
Anya (ML): Also add `quant_path` = [cpu, gpu-kernel-vX], so we can route fallback tests.
Maria L.: Action items:
 - Samir: RFC follow-up to add intake metadata + implement calibration microbench (priority)
 - Anya: define deterministic quant smoke and embedding checksum (small PR)
 - Chris: add telemetry hooks and CI scheduling (nightly/perf store)
 - Devon: prototype CPU vs GPU quant comparison harness
I'll open tickets today. @everyone please +1 or flag concerns by EOD. :thumbsup:
Samir P.: +1
Chris B.: +1
Anya (ML): +1
Devon R.: +1
Maria L.: Thanks — I'll also add a short runbook for interpreting calibration numbers.
